title.narrative: Output 1.1: Awareness and campaign

Impacting the perspective and behaviour of 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 States toward human trafficking, its victims, risks and precautions. Also 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 states are sensitized about the risks and signs of human trafficking, by watching the film and completing pre- and post- film and training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour. Lastly, prevention by identifying trafficking and smuggling cases and reporting of suspicious activities or decrease in trafficking incidents in the 6 states

target.value: Conduct awareness campaigns and educational initiatives to sensitize an additional 10,000 (for composite total of 20,000) people from 50 communities in 6 states about the risks and signs of human trafficking, using pre- and post- training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour.

actual.value: 15,472 individuals reached across 6 communities across five (5) States using the "I Wish I Knew" movie, highlighting survivors' stories, traffickers' tactics, and ways to identify and report trafficking cases.

actual.value: A groundbreaking awareness campaign reached 14,128 individuals through the impactful I Wish I Knew movie, highlighting survivors stories, traffickers tactics, and ways to identify and report trafficking cases. title.narrative: 3.1 High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building

1. Increase in the understanding of human trafficking and smuggling between 50 Nigerian and Danish stakeholders documented by MeCAHT and EXIST. 2. 20 MeCAHT staff have improved operational efficiency in financial competence, project design & management, proposal writing, effective reporting, leadership and responsibility. Consequently, staff are able to maintain the expected standards required for managing larger grants and to communicate more effectively between team members, partners, networks, donors, communities and other stakeholders.

target.value: 1. Host 1 high level advocacy event for 25 stakeholders like the Danish Centre against Human Trafficking, Danish Police, Nigerian diaspora community, Nigerian victims and survivors of Human Trafficking and Smuggling and 6 MeCAHT staff in Denmark to increase awareness on human Trafficking issues. 2. Hold a capacity building training in Nigeria for 20 MeCAHT staff in Financial Management and Administration. 3. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST

actual.value: MeCAHT hosted the I Wish I Knew movie premiere, which had in attendance 64 high-level stakeholders, including ambassadors from Austria, Finland, and Denmark, the Chief of Mission of IOM, representatives of EXIST and NAPTIP, and other key anti-trafficking stakeholders. The premiere served as a platform to raise awareness on the dangers of human trafficking and smuggling through the lived experiences of four survivors featured at the event. Following the screening, the survivors shared their stories through live interviews with TVC, Radio Nigeria, Eagles FM, and Vanguard Newspaper, extending the reach of the awareness campaign beyond the event audience.

target.value: 1. Host 1 high level advocacy event for 25 stakeholders like the Danish Centre against Human Trafficking, Danish Police, Nigerian diaspora community, Nigerian victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling and 6 MeCAHT staff in Denmark to advocate for better coordination of support for victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling. 2. Hold a capacity building training for 20 MeCAHT staff Proposal and Report Writing in Nigeria. 3. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST

actual.value: MeCAHT strengthened collaboration with EXIST and advanced multi-stakeholder engagement through the successful organization of a Survivor-Stakeholder Conference attended by 25 participants. The conference brought together representatives from law enforcement agencies, the Network of Civil Society Organizations Against Child Trafficking, Abuse and Labour (NACTAL), the National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (NAPTIP), the International Organization for Migration (IOM), foreign embassies, victims, returnees, and survivors of human trafficking and migrant smuggling.
